notes.title: There Is No Tomorrow' releases on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33392782/275da6919fb9cf5cdf5184dd92903294d27b068e.jpg[/img]

Get it today while the launch discount lasts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/787120/There_Is_No_Tomorrow

[h1]About[/h1]
'There Is No Tomorrow' is a 3rd person action survival game inspired by The Last of Us & Life is Strange. The story is about Leon who time traveled into the future world that is at the brink of extinction due to a mystery dimensional beings known as 'RA'. 

The game was nominated by Indie Prize Singapore 2017 and showcased by 'Square Enix Collective' in 2018. Recently it was reviewed by IGN SEA.

Features:
⦁        Choose between action or stealth approach
⦁        A story driven adventure game
⦁        Multiple endings based on choices you made
⦁        Challenging Puzzles to solve.
⦁        Hardcore mode (remove listening ability)

notes.title: "Space Ironman" PUNK-EX Early-access Launched!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33392782/69ec7c60232bf23eaccbd0c03eb144ffaefad54f.png[/img]

Hi everyone!, PUNK-EX has now launched on early-access Steam. During this phrase, I will be continuous improving on the game as well as listening to any feedback from players.

Feeling very excited and uncertain as this is my first early-access release as well as my first steam game releases. 

The game is currently 85-90% playable but there will be some bugs that I missed fixing. 

Please post any bug issues Steam discussion forums if you encounter any bugs.ːsteamfacepalmː

Have fun!

notes.title: Coming Soon - 7 days?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33392782/09e8e7de8a6f782bb35f577ea60d6b6d5468a64b.jpg[/img]

[b]PUNK-EX is going to be release on early-access very soon! In 7 days![/b]

The date is set on November 2nd but there's a small possibility of releasing it a few days later if I encounter some problem with the game.

The game is 80% playable with the exception of the final missions. I will be listening to what players think of the game before moving forward with the rest of the game.

I will be updating the Steam page with a new improved trailer tomorrow ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Early-Access & Multiplayer
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

[b] PUNK-EX will be planning to launch in Early-Access on November 2nd 2018.[/b] 

That's the current decision I am going for even though this might change. But right now, this is the direction for the Steam release.

[b] About Multiplayer [/b] 
PUNK-EX already has a PVP mode but it will take time to finalize it. Currently I am removing the 'Multiplayer' label on the game until it is 100% confirmed that the game has multiplayer mode.

I am going to focus more on the Single-player aspect of the game before going into developing multiplayer. So whether or not the game will have multiplayer mode is still unknown.

If anyone has any questions, feel free to ask! Thanks ːsteammockingː
